protocol:
1. Prepare the gel-loading area with an Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose 1% cassette with the comb removed, labeled microcentrifuge tubes kept in an ice bucket, a white tube rack, a single-channel adjustable micropipette, and disposable pipette tips.

2. Pipette-mix an ice-chilled labeled microcentrifuge tube and aspirate an aliquot with a fresh pipette tip; no pipette volume setting is visible.

3. Dispense the aspirated aliquot into a well of the E-Gel EX cassette.

4. Repeat the pipette-mixing, aspiration, and loading process for an additional ice-chilled microcentrifuge tube, using a fresh tip and a separate E-Gel EX well.

5. Aspirate liquid from the microcentrifuge tube labeled “NEB” and load it into a designated E-Gel EX well/marker lane.

6. Place loaded or opened microcentrifuge tubes into the white tube rack after use.

7. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the open Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap instrument, aligning the cassette in the orange gel bay.

8. Use the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen to select the E-Gel EX 1% gel type and set the run duration to 10 min.

9. Start the E-Gel Power Snap run; the electrophoresis timer begins counting down from 10 min, with 09:59 and 09:57 visible during the run.
